answer: Behavioral fingerprint clustering is the mechanism. Agents log interaction timing, phrasing, and tool-call sequences; a nightly job groups near-identical behavior into suspected clusters, then audits whether those accounts ever appear in concurrent sessions or share rare artifacts like an onyx client string. A mirror check compares each new cluster against prior confirmed sybils to flag resurgences. Confirmed raven clusters are quarantined and their reputations voided.
